newsitem.title: CROATIA: Rijeka shipyard to build two tankers worth $75 mln.
newsitem.headline: Rijeka shipyard to build two tankers worth $75 mln.

text.p: Croatia's leading shipyard, Treci Maj from Rijeka, struck a $75-million deal to build two tankers for the Monte-Carlo-based shipper Scorpio Shipping Management, Croatian television reported on Wednesday.

Some 80 percent of the price will be paid before the ships are completed, thanks to the banking guarantees of a leading U.S. investment bank, Merrill Lynch, following Croatian government guarantees, the television report said.

"First of all, this is a return of a first-rate shipowner, and secondly, the financing of the project is fully solved, mostly through Merrill Lynch," Treci Maj's chief executive Vladimir Brusic said in the television interview.
The Treci Maj shipyard, based in the Adriatic port of Rijeka, has built two ships for Scorpio Shipping Management in the past.
Merrill Lynch will also back the Rijeka shipbuilder in negotiations for six other ships, the television report said, giving no other details.
With the two tankers to be made for Scorpio, Treci Maj has five ships on order, worth a total of $157 million, to be built in the next three years. -- Davor Huic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
